name: ERP 应收应付巡检三岗岗位包
description: 应收应付团队的岗位 preset 源：巡检岗（只读核余额与汇率出处）、核对岗（差异定性与 pending 提案，含两源对账）、拍板岗（唯一确认门）。工具面引用 fd-erp-ledger-mcp 8 件，逐岗经 resources.mcpTools 收窄，包级 allowTools 只作封顶；资金执行（资金池/代收代付/分账）一律拒绝（二清红线）。
notes: publish-ready 源清单（待上架/未发布，packId 未铸造）：三岗 persona 只做本地角色，不含 model/baseUrl/凭据；工具面仅引用 registryName=fd-erp-ledger-mcp 并显式声明 8 件 allowTools（包级封顶），再经 resources.mcpTools 按岗收窄（窄化而非放宽）。确认门工具（confirm_proposal / decide_event / approve_billing_rule / approve_posting_rule）只出现在拍板岗；写类工具不出现在巡检岗。消费方：erp-payables-fleet 的三名成员 target。

en.name: ERP Receivables & Payables Inspection — Three Posts
en.description: Role presets for the ERP receivables/payables team: the inspector checks balances and FX rate provenance read-only, the reconciler qualifies differences and files pending proposals (including two-source reconciliation), and the decider holds the sole confirmation gate. Tool face references 8 tools of fd-erp-ledger-mcp, narrowed per post via resources.mcpTools. Fund execution is refused outright.
en.notes: Publish-ready source: personas are local roles only, no credentials. Tool faces reference fd-erp-ledger-mcp with 8 explicit allowTools (pack ceiling), narrowed per post via resources.mcpTools. The confirmation gate appears on the decider only. Consumer: the three member targets of erp-payables-fleet.

erp-payables-discipline.description: Receivables/payables three-post discipline: balances are recomputed from entries, every FX rate must carry a source, reconciliation stops at proposals, confirmation gate belongs to the decider only, fund red line.
